body:
My hypothesis:

Wave consists of waves as a fractal
All "particles" are waves packets or stable configurations of wave.

I need to have accurate simulation that would explain how atom is waving in time, how electron as a wave packet waving around the the atom, how light is result of changing in acceleration of charged waves and so on.

I may be wrong with some details, but I need the most accurate physical simulation we can make to date based on latest science.

I know there many possible math solutions to the same objects or 3D wave configurations. So I want it to be tested using all we know are correct and proven, yet we should only use wave-like math to actually calculate the simulation, yet it must be fully correct according to all best science.

Please make me library and GitHub Pages website to see it on any device, it should support mobile and other screen sized on all OSes.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: My hypothesis is that everything is a wave
